PATitle: Organize a fictional public-domain photo catalogue
PASubtitle: Practise folder choices, captions, and provenance checks with placeholders.
ActivityDescription: Plan the organization of three placeholder photo filenames into a practice catalogue. The fictional rights notes say public domain only for this exercise; no actual images are supplied and no real licence or provenance claim has been verified.
TrainerGuidelines:
Explain the difference between a fictional rights note and verified provenance for a real image.
Demonstrate one catalogue row without renaming or deleting an original.
Leave any unsupported caption or provenance detail as TBD and flag it for review.
DesiredLearningOutcome: The learner can organize placeholder photo records while preserving original names and making unverified provenance visible.
WhatIsNeeded:
Placeholder filename cards: cloud-study.jpg, garden-path.jpg, and paper-sail.jpg
Fictional rights-note cards marked public domain for the exercise only
Practice folder labels: Sky, Garden, and Objects
Blank index with original filename, folder, caption, and provenance-status columns
SkillsBasedLearningObjectives:
Assign a descriptive folder to each placeholder filename.
Preserve original filenames in a catalogue index.
Distinguish an exercise-only rights note from verified real-image provenance.
DocumentationAndReferences: Fictional photo catalogue guide and exercise-only rights-note cards supplied with this demo. No image collection, external licence evidence, or course identifier is supplied.
ActivitySteps:
List the three placeholder filenames and keep their original spellings.
Read each fictional rights note and mark real-image provenance as TBD; do not infer a verified licence.
Assign cloud-study.jpg to Sky, garden-path.jpg to Garden, and paper-sail.jpg to Objects.
Plan a working copy in each chosen folder without renaming or deleting an original.
Record the original filename, folder, a filename-based practice caption, and TBD provenance status in the index.
Check that every placeholder has one index row and flag all provenance entries for review before any real-image use.
Validation:
All three placeholder filenames appear once in the index with the specified folder choices.
Original filenames are preserved and no original is renamed or deleted.
Every provenance-status entry is TBD and visibly flagged for real-image verification.
Notes: Fictional fixture replay, not live AI generation. No actual photos or verified public-domain assets are supplied. Exercise-only rights notes are not licence evidence. Unspecified metadata remains TBD; review before use.
